questions.q: Why did Viktor go to study in Belgrade?
o: He couldn't find a suitable school in his hometown
questions.e: In the video: "Nisam pronalazio odgovarajuće srednje škole u svom gradu, pa sam gledao negde drugde." — I couldn't find suitable high schools in my town, so I looked elsewhere.

questions.q: How does the IT track differ from multimedia?
o: IT is about programming, multimedia about graphics
IT is about video, multimedia about databases
questions.e: In the video: "je IT smer više za programiranje, a multimedija više za grafiku" — IT is more about programming, while multimedia is more about graphics.

questions.q: What did Viktor make in the air pollution project?
questions.e: In the video: "budžetni prečišćivač vazduha, koji sam ja napravio" — a budget air purifier, which I built.

questions.q: How is the purifier's casing made?
questions.e: In the video: "Čitavo kućište je napravljeno 3D štampom" — The whole casing is made by 3D printing.

questions.q: What happens when you press the button on the ECG device?
o: The measurement is sent to a web server
questions.e: In the video: "Kada se klikne dugme, to se šalje na živi web server" — When you click the button, it is sent to a live web server.

questions.q: What is Lea Moon?
questions.e: In the video: "O tome se radi da je to simulacija UN-a." — It is a simulation of the UN.

questions.q: What place did Viktor's team take at the olympiad this year?
questions.e: In the video: "Ove godine je moj tim bio na 76. mestu u svetu" — This year my team was in 76th place in the world.

questions.q: What is the main theme of the First Global competition?
questions.e: In the video: "jeste prijateljstvo i zajednički rad" — is friendship and working together.

questions.q: Škola *naruči* koje delove treba
questions.e: naručiti — to order

questions.q: Samo otvorimo *prozor* i vidimo da je veliko zagađenje.
questions.e: prozor — window

questions.q: a to je prevelika *cifra* za običnog građanina
questions.e: cifra — here: sum, figure

questions.q: Bilo je to divno *iskustvo*
questions.e: iskustvo — experience

questions.q: ali je bila velika *nestašica*
questions.e: nestašica — shortage

questions.q: jer nije bitno koja alijansa *pobedi*
questions.e: pobediti — to win

questions.q: Obeležavamo *rođendane* naučnika
questions.e: rođendan — birthday

questions.q: Vidimo prečišćivače vazduha koji *koštaju* dvesta-trista evra
questions.e: koštati — to cost

questions.q: Od ___ razreda sam tražio koja bi to bila srednja škola.
questions.e: Od + gen.: od osmog razreda — from eighth grade.

questions.q: Pa, osnovnu školu sam završio ___ Crnoj Gori
questions.e: Where? — u + loc. for countries: u Crnoj Gori.

questions.q: I kad projekat ___, imamo takmičenja.
questions.e: A single completed action after kad takes the perfective: završimo.

questions.q: Ko bolje zna programiranje, bavi se programerskim ___
questions.e: Baviti se + instr.: bavi se programerskim delom.

questions.q: Radi ___ struju, na običnu utičnicu.
questions.e: Radi na + acc.: radi na struju — runs on electricity.

questions.q: Ljudi su imali ___ da kupe prečišćivače
questions.e: Imati para — to have money (gen. pl.).

questions.q: Ambasadorka ___ je pričala baš o svojoj misiji
questions.e: Ambasadorka Danske — the ambassador of Denmark (gen.).

questions.q: Prošle godine smo bili ___ u svetu
questions.e: Predicate noun/adjective agrees in nom. masc. pl.: treći.
